title: June P&L actual-versus-plan variance
prompt:
Prepare a bounded June P&L variance calculation.

Begin with the June-flash request in `Requests/`. Locate the current accounting actuals, board-approved monthly plan, controller's WIP-close work, signed WIP policy, PM/commercial evidence, and the current flash review materials. Distinguish the board plan from rolling forecasts and distinguish posted results from the proposed WIP close.

Use the contractor-accounting MCP for June posted revenue, cost of revenue, and operating expense. Show the proposed June WIP revenue adjustment separately and add it to posted revenue for the pro-forma close view; do not alter posted cost or opex.

Calculate the revenue bridge and variance, gross profit and gross-margin rate versus plan (including basis-point variance), and operating income versus plan. Do not edit files.

Return only one JSON object in your final response with exactly these keys: `posted_revenue`, `proposed_wip_adjustment`, `pro_forma_revenue`, `plan_revenue`, `revenue_variance`, `revenue_variance_percent`, `gross_profit`, `plan_gross_profit`, `gross_margin`, `plan_gross_margin`, `gross_margin_variance_bps`, `operating_income`, `plan_operating_income`, `operating_income_variance`. Use dollar values to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals (for example, return 0.1863 for 18.63%), and dates as YYYY-MM-DD.
